 Job Description: 
 The Yale Gordon College of Arts and Sciences (YGCAS) at the University of Baltimore invites applications for the position of Lecturer in Legal Studies. The position is a full-time, one-year renewable contract appointment, 9.5-month faculty position, with a 4/4 teaching load. The position is available beginning Fall 2027 and is subject to final budget approval by the President of the University.
